Its ground space is P H; the three-electron noninteracting determinant Phi is a ground state of dGamma(h_NL), has density n exactly, and retains kinetic expectation Tens[n].

claims.exact_statement: Assume the pinned source's Proposition 4.3, weighted gap (4.23), and Proposition 5.1 for its fixed density n. For the real local function V=Delta g/(2g) in L2_loc, the nonnegative core form q0[f]=1/2 integral |grad f|^2 + integral V|f|^2 on C_c^infty is closable. Under the unitary map f->f/g to L2(g^2 dx), its closure is the weighted Dirichlet form with domain H1(g^2), equivalently D(qbar)={g xi:xi in H1(g^2)}. It contains g,h with qbar[g]=0 and qbar[h]=d. The weighted gap implies the Friedrichs operator has normalized spatial ground orbital g/sqrt(2) at 0 and h at d, with no lower spectrum orthogonal to g. After spin lift, Pauli filling gives a three-electron noninteracting ground determinant (g/sqrt(2) up) wedge (g/sqrt(2) down) wedge (h up), with exact spin-summed density n. This local potential lies outside L3/2+L-infinity by the source's Theorem 6.4.
